name: tax-invoice
title: Tax invoice
for_each: select id, number from invoices where issued_on > park_today() - 30 order by number

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select i.number as "invoice", i.issued_on as "date", s.business_name as "from", case when s.country = 'NZ' then 'GST number ' else 'ABN ' end || s.gst_number as "tax number", g.name as "to", nullif(concat_ws(', ', nullif(g.company, ''), nullif(g.address, ''), nullif(g.email, ''), nullif(g.business_number, '')), '') as "guest details", b.ref as "booking" from invoices i join bookings b on b.id = i.booking_id join guests g on g.id = b.guest_id cross join settings s where i.id = $1

sections.title: Accommodation
sections.sql: select coalesce(si.name, t.name) as "site", n.rate_plan as "rate", min(n.night_on) as "from", max(n.night_on) + 1 as "to", count(*) as nights, round(n.rate_cents / 100.0, 2) as "per night", round(sum(n.rate_cents) / 100.0, 2) as amount from booking_nights n join invoices i on i.booking_id = n.booking_id join bookings b on b.id = n.booking_id join site_types t on t.id = b.site_type_id left join sites si on si.id = b.site_id where i.id = $1 group by si.name, t.name, n.rate_plan, n.rate_cents order by 3

sections.title: Other charges
sections.sql: select x.posted_on as "date", x.description, round(x.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from charges x join invoices i on i.booking_id = x.booking_id where i.id = $1 order by x.posted_on

sections.title: Total
sections.note: Amounts include GST. Where the law sets a reduced value for long stays, GST is worked out on that value.
sections.sql: select s.currency, round(f.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as "total including GST", round(f.gst_cents / 100.0, 2) as "GST included", round(f.paid_cents / 100.0, 2) as paid, round(f.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as "balance owing" from invoices i join v_folio f on f.id = i.booking_id cross join settings s where i.id = $1

sections.title: Payments received
sections.sql: select p.paid_on as "date", p.method, p.reference, round(p.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from payments p join invoices i on i.booking_id = p.booking_id where i.id = $1 order by p.paid_on

name: site-account-statement
title: Site account statement
for_each: select a.id, a.ref || ' ' || g.name as name from agreements a join guests g on g.id = a.guest_id where a.status = 'active' order by a.ref

sections.title: Your agreement
sections.sql: select a.ref as agreement, a.guest as occupant, a.site, a.kind, a.starts_on as "since", a.currency, round(a.fee_cents / 100.0, 2) as "site fee", a.fee_period as "per", a.billed_to as "billed up to", s.business_name as "from", case when s.country = 'NZ' then 'GST number ' else 'ABN ' end || s.gst_number as "tax number" from v_agreements a cross join settings s where a.id = $1

sections.title: Last 90 days
sections.sql: select l.posted_on as "date", l.description, case when l.amount_cents > 0 then round(l.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) end as charged, case when l.amount_cents < 0 then round(-l.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) end as paid, l.reference from account_lines l where l.agreement_id = $1 and l.posted_on > park_today() - 90 order by l.posted_on, l.amount_cents < 0, l.created_at

sections.title: Balance
sections.note: A positive balance is owing to the park; a negative balance is in credit. Please pay by [bank account], quoting your agreement number.
sections.sql: select currency, round(charged_cents / 100.0, 2) as "charged to date", round(paid_cents / 100.0, 2) as "paid to date", round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as "balance", last_paid_on as "last payment" from v_agreements where id = $1

sections.title: Power
sections.sql: select r.read_on as "reading date", r.kwh as "meter (kWh)", r.kwh - lag(r.kwh) over (order by r.read_on) as "used (kWh)" from meter_readings r join agreements a on a.site_id = r.site_id where a.id = $1 and r.read_on >= a.starts_on order by r.read_on desc limit 6

name: arrival-card
title: Arrival card
for_each: select b.id, b.ref from bookings b where b.status = 'confirmed' and b.arrive_on between park_today() and park_today() + 1 order by b.arrive_on, b.ref

sections.title: Your stay
sections.sql: select v.ref as booking, v.guest, v.site_type as "site type", coalesce(v.site, '') as site, v.area, v.arrive_on as arrival, v.depart_on as departure, v.nights, v.adults, v.children, round(v.total_cents / 100.0, 2) as "total including GST", round(v.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as "to pay" from v_bookings v where v.id = $1

sections.title: Your details
sections.note: Please check and complete. We use these details for your stay, your tax invoice and to know who is on site in an emergency.
sections.sql: select g.name, g.email, g.phone, g.address, g.country, b.vehicle_rego as "vehicle registration", b.van_length_m as "van length (m)", '' as "signature" from bookings b join guests g on g.id = b.guest_id where b.id = $1

sections.title: Park times
sections.sql: select s.check_in_time as "check-in from", s.check_out_time as "check-out by", b.requests, b.eta as "arrival time" from bookings b cross join settings s where b.id = $1

name: cabin-cleaning-sheet
title: Cabin cleaning sheet
for_each: select distinct area as id, coalesce(nullif(area, ''), 'All cabins') as name from v_site_status where site_kind in ('cabin', 'unit')

sections.title: Cabins and units
sections.note: Cabins with a guest arriving first. Tick each when done and return the sheet to the office.
sections.sql: select site as cabin, status, job, departs, arriving, eta, '' as "done by" from v_site_status where site_kind in ('cabin', 'unit') and area = $1 order by case when job like 'clean now%' then 0 when job like 'check-out%' then 1 when job = 'stayover tidy' then 2 else 3 end, sort

name: on-site-register
title: On-site register: who is in the park tonight
for_each: select 'tonight' as id, park_today()::text as name

sections.title: Casual guests
sections.note: Print at the night audit and keep at the assembly point with your emergency procedure. Tick each party once they are accounted for.
sections.sql: select v.site, v.guest, v.adults, v.children, g.phone, v.vehicle_rego as rego, v.depart_on as departs, '' as "accounted for" from v_bookings v join guests g on g.id = v.guest_id where v.status = 'checked_in' and $1::text is not null order by v.site

sections.title: Long-stay occupants
sections.sql: select a.site, a.guest as occupant, a.occupants as people, g.phone, ag.vehicle_rego as rego, a.kind, '' as "accounted for" from v_agreements a join guests g on g.id = a.guest_id join agreements ag on ag.id = a.id where a.status = 'active' and a.starts_on <= park_today() and $1::text is not null order by a.site

sections.title: Arriving later tonight
sections.sql: select coalesce(v.site, 'not assigned') as site, v.guest, v.adults, v.children, b.eta from v_bookings v join bookings b on b.id = v.id where v.status = 'confirmed' and v.arrive_on = park_today() and $1::text is not null order by v.site

name: meter-sheet
title: Meter reading sheet
for_each: select 'meters' as id, park_today()::text as name

sections.title: Metered long-stay sites
sections.note: Write the reading in kWh and the date. Enter each one with read-meter, then run bill-power.
sections.sql: select site, guest as occupant, last_read_on as "last read", last_kwh as "last reading", state, '' as "today's reading" from v_meters where $1::text is not null order by site
